notes: NEW: CAMPAIGN - FIRST HARVEST. A 12-mission story, three weeks before the night Blackwell fell. On the main menu: CAMPAIGN. Missions 1 and 2 are here; more come in the next updates.

MISSION 1 · LAST DELIVERY (the Greenhouse): VANTAGE raids the Green Coast Collective. Pack the order, hold the greenhouse, wipe the member list, get Mara out, carry the harvest, protect the van and take down CAPTAIN KESS.

MISSION 2 · THE PLUG (Blackwater Pier): meet Smokes, photograph the grey boats without being seen, sneak into the cannery, find the manifest, catch the fake buyer and cover Smokes with a sniper rifle.
Every mission: checkpoints, the crew fights beside you and talks, 3 hidden STASH TINS, RECRUIT / REGULAR / VETERAN, and XP when you finish. Pause menu: RESTART FROM CHECKPOINT.
Also in this update: the 1.2.57 fixes (Contact High one-hit infected bots, no finishers on zombies, zombies leaderboard).
